entry.title: 3 Friends, One World Title, Who Gets It First?

media:group.media:title: 3 Friends, One World Title, Who Gets It First?
media:group.media:description:
Jack Robinson, Kanoa Igarashi and Leo Fioravanti were all tipped as future world champions as kids. None of them has won a World Title yet.
ONE MORE follows the three childhood friends and Championship Tour rivals as they break mid-season for ten days of jersey-free surfing on a boat trip through Indonesia's Mentawai Islands, with one of them ranked world No. 1 at the time. Away from heats and scoring, it's a rare look at their chemistry, shared history and unfinished pursuit of a World Title: where three careers destined for greatness stand now, and which of them, if any, will reach the top first.
Filmed in the Mentawais, known for its long, perfectly shaped barrels and one of Indonesia's benchmark locations for progressive surfing.

entry.title: Big Airs, Big Barrels and Broken Boards | NST Live in Africa

media:group.media:title: Big Airs, Big Barrels and Broken Boards | NST Live in Africa
media:group.media:description:
Twelve of the world’s most fearless freesurfers. Ten days up South Africa’s coastline. No two sessions the same. Natural Selection Surf heads into a remote zone where long point breaks, heavy slabs and barreling beach breaks at Mother Nature’s choosing become the proving ground for a new approach to surf competition.
Returning champions Milla Coco Brown and Soli Bailey face off with Kirra Pinkerton, Noah Beschen, Eithan Osborne, Eden Walla, Sanoa Dempfle-Olin, Eli Beukes, Balaram Stack, Hughie Vaughan, Jarvis Earle and Mikey Wright. They’ll chase the best waves they can find, take on whatever the ocean serves up, and push each other into unfamiliar territory. The goal, according to Head Judge Nathan Fletcher, “the guy and girl who surf the best overall win.”
